full_judgment: 9. The learned Advocate Mr. Khurshid Alam Khan appearing on behalf of the pre-emptees-petitioners submitted that the Court of appeal below being the final Court of fact without considering the discussing the evidences reversed the judgment of the trial Court and as such it is not a proper judgment of reversal which appears to have committed error of lain, resulting in an error in the impugned decision occasioning failure of justice in the case.
